description: Defines classes and interfaces for handling HTTP digest authentication, including nonce generation strategies, and the main HttpAuthHandlerDigest class with related enums and methods.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerDigest
classes.description: Main class for handling HTTP digest authentication, including nonce generation and challenge parsing.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerDigest::DynamicNonceGenerator
classes.description: Generates a random shuffle of characters for nonces.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerDigest::FixedNonceGenerator
classes.description: Uses a fixed string as the client nonce.

classes.name: HttpAuthHandlerDigest::Factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating HttpAuthHandlerDigest instances.

methods.name: GenerateNonce
methods.description: Generates a client nonce (static method in HttpAuthHandlerDigest).

methods.name: GetRequestMethodAndPath
methods.description: Extracts HTTP method and path from request.
